I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting their SMS bay assignments at check-in. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct. The note also says the kiosk logs needed archiving before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from *Moss: North cheat sheet* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md, undated). Thea logged it too. The gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 product support for firmware testing.

A few things to keep in mind:
- Moss's 9/14 pipeline digest and 3/23/2026 renewal check-in both mention QFL, but neither has a ticket number.
- The cheat sheet warns against mixing QFL up with **Quarendon Freightways**, a different company with one "r" that isn't our customer. Marcus has a competitive-intel note on them. I left it out because it isn't about QFL and isn't one of Moss's notes.
- The ticket numbers in Moss's Central notes (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to Marrow accounts, not QFL.
- I only checked Moss's shared notes. I didn't look through the #inc-qfl-sev1 channel, so tell me if you want that searched too.
